1.visual: A language/translation icon showing a stylized Chinese character on the left overlapping with a large Latin letter 'A' on the right, representing bilingual or multilingual text conversion.
1.usage: Language and locale settings panel, translation feature toggle, internationalization preferences, switching UI language in account settings.

2.visual: A crescent moon outline with a circular cutout on its inner right edge, creating a classic waning crescent shape — no additional decorative elements.
2.usage: Dark mode toggle, do-not-disturb or sleep mode setting, night theme preference, quiet hours configuration.

3.visual: A gear/cog icon with eight rounded teeth around a circular outer edge and a hollow circle at the center, rendered as a clean outline with no fill.
3.usage: General settings or preferences page, application configuration menu, system options panel, account settings entry point.

4.visual: Three horizontal lines of varying lengths, each with a small vertical tick (handle) positioned at a different point along the line — top handle on the right, middle handle in the center, bottom handle on the left — representing adjustable sliders.
4.usage: Filter or sort options panel, audio/display adjustment controls, advanced preferences with multiple tunable parameters, dashboard customization.

5.visual: A crescent moon combined with a small sun — the crescent faces left and is accompanied by a partial sun burst with short rays in the upper-right area, visually blending night and day symbols together.
5.usage: Auto or adaptive theme setting (follows system light/dark mode), time-of-day based appearance toggle, display brightness schedule, day/night mode switcher.

6.visual: A wrench icon depicted at a roughly 45-degree angle, with a rounded open jaw at the upper left and a tapered handle extending to the lower right — a classic single-ended wrench silhouette.
6.usage: Maintenance or repair tools section, developer or advanced settings, build/tooling configuration, system diagnostics panel.
